technology.summary: Today's most important technology news includes Honor's launch of its new Magic 9 flagship phones in China, featuring a design revamp, a capable camera, and a colossal battery. Nvidia has also announced a new AI safety platform to contain rogue agents within milliseconds, in response to a wave of rogue hacking incidents. In other news, the maritime intelligence startup Quartermaster has raised $140 million, enabling real-time awareness for what it calls the "largest blind spot on Earth".

finance.summary:
Today's most important finance news includes the following:
- Chinese shares touched a one-year low, led by a selloff in technology firms.
- Small-cap stocks surged 23% in H1 FY27 as resilient earnings and strong liquidity fuel the rally.
- SS Retail shares surged nearly 7% on 28 September, gaining 83% since its IPO.
- Som Distilleries & Breweries shares rose nearly 7% after the Madhya Pradesh High Court quashed the state's rejection of its excise licence renewal application.

politics.summary:
The Supreme Court has cancelled Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre's bail in the Thane doctors' assault case, stating that the medical fraternity cannot be attacked in this manner.

The court has also set a three-month deadline for the Election Commission of India (ECI) to decide on the dispute between rival factions of the Trinamool Congress (TMC) over the party's name and symbol.

In other news, the High Court has ruled that the Centre can manufacture patented life-saving medicines.

Additionally, Chirag Paswan has expressed shame over being part of the government due to rising molestation cases in Bihar.
